barks.text: Another one... hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm... not from the twelve, one, are you?
You're new. hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm... Not like my twelve, one, lost in the rock.
Hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm... I keep it safe, twelve, one, safe from new eyes.
Another new face... hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm. You won't take what's left, twelve, one.
You're new, hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm... I keep it safe, twelve, one.
New face... hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm... you weren't with the twelve, one.
Hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm, a new face. Not one of my twelve, not one.
They found me... hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm... lost from the twelve, one.
A new face, hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm. Twelve, one. Always more coming now.
Who's that? Hmm-hmm-hmm-hmm, I lost twelve, not one, not one.
